notes: אשר ... שם is fused into whither, which still carries both the relative and the locative sense, so rule 35's far-side reasoning rather than rule 30's contiguity condition governs; the competing reading (whither to אשר, שם unrepresented under rule 22) is named in that unit's note.
The that of in the day that he is realizes the construct relation and so goes on the infinitive as rectum (rule 52's last clause).
